WITH matched AS (
  SELECT p.SEX, l.WBC * 1.0 / NULLIF(l.PLT, 0) AS wbc_plt, l.HGB * 1.0 / NULLIF(l.HCT, 0) AS hgb_hct
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
),
by_sex AS (
  SELECT SEX, AVG(wbc_plt) AS avg_wbc_plt, AVG(hgb_hct) AS avg_hgb_hct
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY SEX
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wbc_plt) AS overall_avg_wbc_plt
  FROM by_sex
)
SELECT b.SEX, b.avg_wbc_plt, b.avg_hgb_hct, b.avg_wbc_plt - o.overall_avg_wbc_plt
FROM by_sex AS b
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.overall_avg_wbc_plt IS NOT NULL
